Apple___Apple_scab.symptoms: Dark, scabby lesions on leaves and fruit
treatments: Remove and destroy infected leaves
Apply fungicides (myclobutanil or captan) during wet periods
Prune trees to improve air circulation
Apply dormant spray in early spring
prevention: Rake and remove fallen leaves in autumn

Apple___Black_rot.symptoms: Circular brown spots on leaves, fruit rot
treatments: Remove all mummified fruit and cankers
Apply fungicides (captan or thiophanate-methyl)
Prune infected branches 6-8 inches below visible symptoms
prevention: Maintain tree health through proper fertilization

Tomato___Early_blight.symptoms: Dark brown spots with concentric rings on lower leaves
treatments: Apply fungicides (chlorothalonil or copper-based)
Remove infected lower leaves
Mulch around plants to prevent soil splash
Water at the base of plants, avoid wetting foliage
prevention: Rotate crops (don't plant tomatoes in same spot for 3 years)
Space plants properly for good air circulation
Stake or cage plants to keep foliage off ground
organic_options: Baking soda spray (1 tablespoon per gallon water)

Tomato___Late_blight.symptoms: Water-soaked spots on leaves, white mold on undersides, fruit rot
treatments: Immediately remove and destroy all infected plants
Apply fungicides (chlorothalonil, mancozeb) preventatively
Do NOT compost infected material - burn or dispose in trash
Clean tools with 10% bleach solution
prevention: Use certified disease-free seed potatoes and transplants
Monitor weather for conditions favoring blight (cool, wet)
organic_options: Remove infected plants immediately to protect others

Potato___Early_blight.symptoms: Dark spots with target-like pattern on lower leaves
treatments: Apply fungicides containing chlorothalonil or mancozeb
Remove infected leaves from bottom of plant
Hill soil around plants to cover lower stems

Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.symptoms: Reddish-brown pustules on both sides of leaves
treatments: Usually doesn't require treatment in most cases
Apply fungicides if infection is severe (propiconazole)
No action needed if infection occurs after tasseling
prevention: Early planting to avoid peak rust season

Grape___Black_rot.symptoms: Reddish-brown spots on leaves, black mummified fruit
treatments: Apply fungicides (myclobutanil or captan) starting at bloom
Remove and destroy all mummified fruit
Prune to improve air circulation
Continue fungicide applications through mid-summer
prevention: Sanitation is critical - remove ALL mummies
Remove infected canes during dormant pruning

treatments: Continue regular monitoring
Maintain current care practices
prevention: Monitor regularly for early disease detection
